purpose.objective: Complete the unified Herdr entrypoint, durable Codex unattended-work continuity, coherent common/native-runtime filesystem ownership and Git/GitHub CI delivery while preserving the paused source Work and live Hermes/Desktop services.
successCriteria: Exact WSL command herdr --remote srv1873899 and one ready user-facing native Codex Orchestrator.
Native Hermes TUI and on-demand Codex workers use existing native owners without a second scheduler.
Durable automatic long-work Goal/plan/checkpoint routing is source-controlled and natively discoverable.
Source/runtime/data/artifact/cache paths have one coherent contract, justified normalization and verified references.
Common/Codex/Hermes Harness source and Work records remain modules of agent-platform; independent project/native state owners remain distinct.
Git branches, exact independent review and CI checks cover changed source and relevant path/skill/deployment contracts.
Original source Work remains paused; no historical effect replay; current receipts and manual continuation survive compaction and cross-host handoff.
inScope: Authorized Herdr/VPS integration and whole-stack network/path/naming optimization
Common and runtime-specific Harness routing and source/delivery consistency
Git/GitHub, bounded CI gates, independent readback and compaction continuity
outOfScope: Automatic original Work resume or native evaluation/model verification prompts
Academy/ministry business effects, prior effect replay, native-store or credential transplantation
Automatic merge, unrelated service restarts, foreign firewall flushes or provider policy claims
Future Claude/Antigravity installation and complete Windows/WSL retirement
